title: Little Nemo, Volume 1
#description: Nemo journeys nightly to Slumberland and wakes, every time, on the last panel. Collects the Sunday pages from October 1905 through the end of 1906.

title: Little Nemo, Volume 2
#description: The Slumberland pages of 1907 and 1908, in which the walking bed, the shrinking house and the ice palace all arrive.

title: Little Nemo: A Slumberland Interlude
#description: A short run of pages published between the second and third collections, gathered here for the first time.

title: Little Nemo, Volume 3
#description: The final Herald years, ending with the strip's move and its change of name.

title: Krazy Kat, Volume 3
#description: Ignatz throws the brick, Krazy takes it as devotion, and Offissa Pupp despairs. The 1918 and 1919 Sundays.

title: Gasoline Alley, Vol. 1
#description: Walt finds a baby on his doorstep and the strip quietly begins ageing its characters in real time.

title: The Yellow Kid in McFadden's Flats
#description: Hogan's Alley collected into a book, with the Kid's nightshirt doing most of the talking.
